_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and sizes the one sensor. experience 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. ⚑ QUESTS (conversation-journal Q4/R3): offers AND turns in `the-lost-lamp`, now the simple three-stage version — he HAS a lamp and is done travelling (the kobolds are why he stopped, which is how the Lampless name survives him handing one over); kill 6 kobolds and it is yours. His turn-in row is the ONLY source of the Lantern aura in the world (L5b — the kobold drops died with this chunk) plus 700 XP. ⚑ Q4 SHAPE (R1): the greeting at root, the quest behind its own row with its brief as that node's text. Quest rows carry NO quest_at_stage gate — a row is shown iff its ledger op would succeed (the Q1 show-rule), so Accept vanishes once taken and the turn-in appears exactly when walkable, while the question row stays askable. The one conditional node left is the completed-state greeting: it sits ABOVE root because the entry node is the first visible one.
name: LamplessTraveller

lines: Still here, aye. But lit. There's a difference, and you're the reason for it.
Sitting is free. Walking in the dark is not.

options.text: Why are you sitting out here?

lines: Kobolds. They made the road theirs, and I am done walking it.
Six of them dead and my lamp is yours — a man going nowhere has no use for one.

grants.line: Then it's settled. North of the tunnel — you'll hear them before you see them.
...So they are. Then it's yours. Watch, now —
A lamp is not a thing you carry. It is a thing you learn. Hold it like so, and the dark stops being a wall.
Go on into that tunnel, then. It's only black until somebody walks in lit.

lines: North of the tunnel, where the trees thin to scree. Follow the chittering.
